tokenLocation.Name: Token Location
tokenLocation.Hint: Where finished tokens are saved. Next to the portrait falls back to the storage folder when the portrait is in a folder that can't be written to, such as Foundry's own icons, a system or module folder, or another website.

storagePath.Name: Storage Folder
storagePath.Hint: Folder where Token Studio saves portraits, uploaded art and work in progress, and tokens that can't be saved next to the portrait.

outputResolution.Name: Token Resolution
outputResolution.Hint: Width and height of saved tokens in pixels, for one grid square.

defaultFrame.Name: Default Frame
defaultFrame.Hint: Frame that Token Studio starts with for actors you haven't edited yet.
